title.en: The equality of women and men
title.fr: L'égalité des femmes et des hommes

text.en: In Canada, the law treats men and women as equals.
text.fr: Au Canada, la loi traite les hommes et les femmes comme des égaux.

source.quote: In Canada, men and women are equal under the law.

text.en: Canada is open and generous, but not toward barbaric cultural practices that accept violence based on gender. That includes abuse of a husband or wife, so-called "honour killings", female genital mutilation and forced marriage.
text.fr: Le Canada est ouvert et généreux, mais pas envers les pratiques culturelles barbares qui acceptent la violence fondée sur le sexe. Cela comprend la violence envers un conjoint, les soi-disant « crimes d'honneur », la mutilation génitale des femmes et le mariage forcé.

source.quote: Canada’s openness and generosity do not extend to barbaric cultural practices that tolerate spousal abuse, “honour killings,” female genital mutilation, forced marriage or other gender-based violence.

text.en: People found guilty of these crimes face severe punishment under Canada's criminal laws.
text.fr: Les personnes reconnues coupables de ces crimes sont sévèrement punies en vertu des lois pénales du Canada.

source.quote: Those guilty of these crimes are severely punished under Canada’s criminal laws.
